title: MarketMindEventEnvelope
description: Standard CloudEvents v1.0 compatible envelope for MarketMind Kafka topics.

id.description: Unique UUID for the event occurrence.

source.description: URI identifying the producer service (e.g., marketmind/market-data-service).

type.description: Domain event type following reverse-DNS or domain format (e.g., filing.ingested.v1).

time.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when event occurred.

correlationid.description: Trace correlation identifier spanning multiple requests.
